notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): The template half is a faithful twin: ItemTemplateCache is ask-once per entry with in-flight dedupe and cached negatives (high-bit miss), and the full 5875 SMSG_ITEM_QUERY_SINGLE_RESPONSE body is decoded including stats, damages, spells, material and sheath; displayId->icon resolves without waiting on the round trip. Item instances stream through the shared entity store and are read back via the player/container descriptor slots (Program.Inventory's ResolveInventoryItem). The enchant-facing and right-click-open halves of Benilla's module have no counterpart.
